mapper.sql: t.id, t.member_id, t.procedure_id, t.saved_revision, p.revision AS current_revision, NVL(pi.title, t.saved_title) AS saved_title, t.status, t.memo, TO_CHAR(t.visit_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS visit_date, TO_CHAR(t.completed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS completed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM JL_USER_TASK t JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = t.procedure_id LEFT JOIN JL_PROCEDURE_I18N pi ON pi.procedure_id = t.procedure_id AND pi.language_code = #{language} WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT FROM JL_USER_TASK t JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = t.procedure_id LEFT JOIN JL_PROCEDURE_I18N pi ON pi.procedure_id = t.procedure_id AND pi.language_code = #{language} WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT t.id, t.member_id, t.procedure_id, t.saved_revision, t.saved_title, t.status, t.memo, TO_CHAR(t.visit_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS visit_date, TO_CHAR(t.completed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS completed_at FROM JL_USER_TASK t WHERE t.procedure_id = #{procedureId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT uc.id, NVL(di.name, uc.document_name) AS document_name, uc.requirement, NVL(di.condition_text, uc.condition_text) AS condition_text, uc.display_order, uc.checked FROM JL_USER_CHECK uc JOIN JL_USER_TASK ut ON ut.id = uc.task_id LEFT JOIN JL_DOCUMENT d ON d.procedure_id = ut.procedure_id AND d.display_order = uc.display_order LEFT JOIN JL_DOCUMENT_I18N di ON di.document_id = d.id AND di.language_code = #{language} WHERE uc.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY uc.display_order
mapper.insert: SELECT jl_user_task_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUALINSERT INTO JL_USER_TASK (id, member_id, procedure_id, saved_revision, saved_title, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{memberId}, #{procedureId}, #{savedRevision}, #{savedTitle}, 'NOT_STARTED')

SELECT jl_user_check_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUALINSERT INTO JL_USER_CHECK (id, task_id, document_name, requirement, condition_text, display_order, checked) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{documentName}, #{requirement}, #{conditionText}, #{displayOrder}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE JL_USER_CHECK SET checked = #{checked} WHERE id = #{checkId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE JL_USER_TASK SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMPNULL WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.task_id, e.member_id, TO_CHAR(e.event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_date, e.title, e.memo, e.completed, NVL(pi.title, t.saved_title) AS task_title FROM JL_USER_TASK_EVENT e JOIN JL_USER_TASK t ON t.id = e.task_id LEFT JOIN JL_PROCEDURE_I18N pi ON pi.procedure_id = t.procedure_id AND pi.language_code = #{language} WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.event_date >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND e.event_date < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY e.event_date, e.id

SELECT e.id, e.task_id, e.member_id, TO_CHAR(e.event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_date, e.title, e.memo, e.completed, t.saved_title AS task_title FROM JL_USER_TASK_EVENT e JOIN JL_USER_TASK t ON t.id = e.task_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: SELECT jl_user_task_event_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO JL_USER_TASK_EVENT (id, task_id, member_id, event_date, title, memo, completed) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{memberId}, TO_DATE(#{eventDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{title}, #{memo}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE JL_USER_TASK_EVENT SET completed = #{completed}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM JL_USER_TASK_EVENT WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
